comment: Chat core files that still import Slack code. Shrink-only: tests/lib/chat-core-boundary.test.ts fails on a file that is not listed and on an entry whose file no longer violates. Each entry says what the Slack import is and what moves it (docs/architecture/CHAT_MODULE.md, docs/TODO.md 'Chat core and Slack adapter: next steps').

files.src/app/(member)/chat/[id]/page.tsx: Calls the Slack gap-fill (catchUpChannel). Moves behind a transport 'catch up' method with the inbound step.
files.src/app/api/process/chat/route.ts: The nightly Bronze-to-Silver run: Slack user matching and lesson links pasted in Slack. Splits into core's projection and the adapter's inbound step (step 3).
files.src/lib/chat/access.ts: Reads the Slack connection status to decide who may chat. Becomes transport.isConnected plus a core access rule.
files.src/lib/chat/avatar-copy.ts: Copies Slack profile photos into the avatar bucket (SLACK_AVATAR_BUCKET). Moves to the adapter with the author mapping (step 3).
files.src/lib/chat/emoji.ts: Reads Slack's emoji short-code map (SLACK_EMOJI_MAP) for the shared emoji catalog. The map is the emoji standard's names; moves to a core emoji data file.
files.src/lib/chat/file-token.ts: Picks the Slack token that may download a file and copies it from Slack (ensureSlackFileCopied). Becomes a transport 'fetch file bytes' method (step 3).
files.src/lib/chat/load.ts: Builds a Slack permalink for a message (formatSlackPermalink). Becomes a transport 'permalink' method.
files.src/lib/chat/names.ts: Builds Slack author photo URLs (slackPhotoUrl). Moves to the adapter's author mapping (step 3).
